facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communique of 18 September 2026 records adoption of a draft decree setting how the qualified electronic signature certificate and other trust services are issued in Gabon, covering electronic signature and seal, website authentication, electronic invoice and the approval conditions and duties of providers, to secure the legal value of electronic transactions; the communique does not name the parent law.
facts.system: decree on qualified electronic signature certificate and trust services

facts.fact: Law No. 025/2021 of 28 December 2021, published in Journal Officiel no. 145 of 1 January 2022, regulates electronic transactions in Gabon: it gives electronic acts, writings, signatures and invoices the same probative force as paper and sets rules for e-commerce, distance contracts and consumer withdrawal; the text gives no date of entry into force, so the promulgation date is used.
facts.system: Loi N° 025/2021 portant réglementation des transactions électroniques

note: Passages file holds only the title, scope and a truncated definitions article of the electronic communications law; it states nothing on electronic transactions or e-commerce.
